name: Bugia numeral instruction
summary: Leonardo of Pisa (Fibonacci) wrote that in Bugia, North Africa, he was taught to calculate with the nine Indian figures, learning he later set out in Liber abaci.
description: Leonardo Pisano reports receiving instruction in calculation with the nine Indian figures while his father served the Pisan merchant community at Bugia.
